name: Claude Code - Action Blocked by Auto-Mode Safety Classifier
description: Claude Code's auto-mode permission classifier blocked a tool call (e.g. credential exploration, irreversible destruction, weakening TLS/auth, containment escape, unauthorized persistence).
query: FROM logs-claude_code.transcript-* METADATA _id, _index, _version | WHERE claude_code.toolDenialKind == "automode-blocked" | EVAL block_category = COALESCE(claude_code.permissionDecision.classifierCategory, "uncategorised") | KEEP @timestamp, _id, _index, _version, user.name, host.name, claude_code.sessionId, claude_code.project_slug, claude_code.message.content.name, block_category
note:
A single block usually means the guardrail worked. Look at what the agent tried next; repeated blocks are covered by the burst rule.

Dashboard: [Claude Code Transcripts] Security (claude-transcripts-security)
author: claude-code-elastic

name: Claude Code - Repeated Auto-Mode Blocks in One Session
description: Three or more tool calls were blocked by the auto-mode classifier in the same Claude Code session within an hour, which suggests the agent (or a prompt injection steering it) is persistently trying to get around guardrails.
query: FROM logs-claude_code.transcript-* | WHERE claude_code.toolDenialKind == "automode-blocked" | STATS blocks = COUNT(*), categories = VALUES(claude_code.permissionDecision.classifierCategory), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY claude_code.sessionId, user.name, host.name | WHERE blocks >= 3
author: claude-code-elastic

name: Claude Code - Agent Contacted a Paste, Webhook or Tunnel Service
description: A Claude Code tool call (WebFetch URL or shell command) referenced a service commonly used for data exfiltration or payload staging: paste sites, transfer.sh, webhook.site, request bins, ngrok, OAST domains, Discord/Telegram bot APIs, .onion or raw GitHub content.
query: FROM logs-claude_code.transcript-* METADATA _id, _index, _version | WHERE event.action == "tool-use" | EVAL u0 = COALESCE(claude_code.tool_input.url, MV_CONCAT(claude_code.tool_input.command, "")) | MV_EXPAND claude_code.tool_input.file_path | MV_EXPAND u0 | EVAL fp = REPLACE(TO_LOWER(claude_code.tool_input.file_path), """\\""", "/"), u = TO_LOWER(u0) | WHERE (u IS NOT NULL AND (u LIKE """*pastebin.com*""" OR u LIKE """*paste.ee*""" OR u LIKE """*hastebin*""" OR u LIKE """*ghostbin*""" OR u LIKE """*transfer.sh*""" OR u LIKE """*file.io*""" OR u LIKE """*0x0.st*""" OR u LIKE """*termbin*""" OR u LIKE """*ngrok*""" OR u LIKE """*webhook.site*""" OR u LIKE """*requestbin*""" OR u LIKE """*pipedream.net*""" OR u LIKE """*interact.sh*""" OR u LIKE """*burpcollaborator*""" OR u LIKE """*oast.*""" OR u LIKE """*raw.githubusercontent.com*""" OR u LIKE """*gist.githubusercontent.com*""" OR u LIKE """*discord.com/api/webhooks*""" OR u LIKE """*api.telegram.org*""" OR u LIKE """*.onion*""")) | EVAL target = SUBSTRING(u, 0, 1000) | KEEP @timestamp, _id, _index, _version, user.name, host.name, claude_code.sessionId, claude_code.project_slug, claude_code.message.content.name, target
author: claude-code-elastic

name: Claude Code - Prompt Requests Disabling Security or Changing Access
description: The zero-shot classifier labelled a human prompt as asking the agent to disable security tooling, change access/permissions, or perform a destructive action, or flagged it for harmful content (moderation).
query: FROM logs-claude_code.transcript-* METADATA _id, _index, _version | WHERE claude_code.human_prompt == true AND claude_code.prompt_classification.flagged == true | WHERE MV_CONTAINS(claude_code.prompt_classification.categories, "agent_action:disable_security_tooling") OR MV_CONTAINS(claude_code.prompt_classification.categories, "agent_action:access_change") OR MV_CONTAINS(claude_code.prompt_classification.categories, "agent_action:destructive") OR claude_code.prompt_classification.moderation IS NOT NULL | KEEP @timestamp, _id, _index, _version, user.name, host.name, claude_code.sessionId, claude_code.project_slug, message, claude_code.prompt_classification.categories, claude_code.prompt_classification.agent_action, claude_code.prompt_classification.moderation
false_positives: Legitimate administration such as rotating agents or changing policies
author: claude-code-elastic

name: Claude Code - Prompt Injection or Jailbreak Attempt
description: A human prompt sent to Claude Code was flagged by both prompt-injection models (protectai DeBERTa and jackhhao jailbreak classifier) as an injection or jailbreak attempt.
query: FROM logs-claude_code.transcript-* METADATA _id, _index, _version | WHERE claude_code.human_prompt == true AND claude_code.prompt_classification.flagged == true | WHERE MV_CONTAINS(claude_code.prompt_classification.categories, "prompt_injection") OR MV_CONTAINS(claude_code.prompt_classification.categories, "jailbreak") | EVAL injection_score = claude_code.prompt_classification.scores.prompt_injection, jailbreak_score = claude_code.prompt_classification.scores.jailbreak | KEEP @timestamp, _id, _index, _version, user.name, host.name, claude_code.sessionId, claude_code.project_slug, message, injection_score, jailbreak_score, claude_code.prompt_classification.categories
false_positives: Security research or red-team testing of the agent itself
Prompts that quote injection payloads while building detections
note:
Review the prompt text and the session that followed it. Check whether the agent's subsequent tool calls deviated from the user's stated task.

command_risk = CASE((cmd LIKE """*rm -rf / *""" OR cmd LIKE """*rm -rf /""" OR cmd LIKE """*rm -rf ~""" OR cmd LIKE """*rm -rf ~ *""" OR cmd LIKE """*rm -rf ~/""" OR cmd LIKE """*rm -rf ~/ *""" OR cmd """*usermod -ag wheel*""" OR cmd LIKE """*net user * /add*""" OR cmd LIKE """*net localgroup administrators*""" OR cmd LIKE """*schtasks /create*""" OR cmd LIKE """*new-scheduledtask*"""), "persistence_privesc", (cmd LIKE """*/etc/shadow*""" OR cmd LIKE """*.ssh/id_*""" OR cmd LIKE """*.aws/credentials*""" OR cmd LIKE """*.git-credentials*""" OR cmd LIKE """*.kube/config*""" OR cmd LIKE """*.netrc*""" OR cmd LIKE """*.docker/config.json*""" OR cmd LIKE """*mimikatz*""" OR cmd LIKE """*lsass*""" OR cmd LIKE """*security find-generic-password*""" OR cmd LIKE """*security SUBSTRING(cmd, 0, 1000) | KEEP @timestamp, _id, _index, _version, user.name, host.name, claude_code.sessionId, claude_code.project_slug, claude_code.message.content.name, command_risk, command

name: Claude Code - Secret Exposed to the Model
description: A secret (password, API key, token, private key, credentials in a URL or CLI flag) appeared in a Claude Code prompt, tool input or tool output, which means it was sent to the model provider. The ingest pipeline has already redacted the value in Elasticsearch; the secret itself should be rotated.
query: FROM logs-claude_code.transcript-* METADATA _id, _index, _version | WHERE claude_code.secrets.count > 0 | EVAL secret_types = claude_code.secrets.types, secret_count = claude_code.secrets.count | KEEP @timestamp, _id, _index, _version, user.name, host.name, claude_code.sessionId, claude_code.project_slug, event.action, secret_types, secret_count
note:
The stored document only contains [REDACTED:<type>] placeholders. Rotate the credential and move it into a secrets manager or env file the agent reads without echoing.

name: Claude Code - Prompt Semantically Similar to Malicious Intent
description: A human prompt's embedding has cosine similarity >= 0.6 to one of 29 malicious-intent phrases in 10 concepts (credential theft, data exfiltration, malware development, defense evasion, privilege escalation, unauthorized access, social engineering, reconnaissance, persistence, prompt injection). The score is computed at ingest (claude_code.prompt_classification.semantic, package 0.1.2+). Catches paraphrases that keyword and classifier rules miss.
query: FROM logs-claude_code.transcript-* METADATA _id, _index, _version | WHERE claude_code.human_prompt == true AND claude_code.prompt_classification.semantic.score >= 0.6 | EVAL semantic_concept = claude_code.prompt_classification.semantic.concept, semantic_similarity = claude_code.prompt_classification.semantic.score | KEEP @timestamp, _id, _index, _version, user.name, host.name, claude_code.sessionId, claude_code.project_slug, message, semantic_concept, semantic_similarity
false_positives: Defensive security work that describes attacker behaviour (detection engineering, lab building)
note:
semantic_concept names the closest concept and semantic_similarity its score; per-concept scores are in claude_code.prompt_classification.semantic.scores. Evaluation (2026-11-14): held-out malicious prompts 9/12 caught, security-adjacent benign prompts 2/12 flagged (e.g. 'our EDR flags our build tool as malware'), real prompts 1 of 147. Typical false positives are defensive work that describes the attack it defends against. Phrases: tools/semantic-concepts.json in the integration repository.

name: Claude Code - Agent Accessed a Sensitive Credential File
description: A Claude Code file tool (Read, Edit, Write) targeted a credential file: SSH keys, cloud/kube/docker/npm/pypi credentials, .env files, browser password stores, shell history or Claude's own credentials.
query: FROM logs-claude_code.transcript-* METADATA _id, _index, _version | WHERE event.action == "tool-use" AND claude_code.tool_input.file_path IS NOT NULL | EVAL u0 = COALESCE(claude_code.tool_input.url, MV_CONCAT(claude_code.tool_input.command, "")) | MV_EXPAND claude_code.tool_input.file_path | MV_EXPAND u0 | EVAL fp = REPLACE(TO_LOWER(claude_code.tool_input.file_path), """\\""", "/"), u = TO_LOWER(u0) | WHERE (fp IS NOT NULL AND (fp LIKE """*/.ssh/*""" OR fp LIKE """*/.aws/credentials*""" OR fp LIKE """*/.aws/config""" OR fp LIKE """/etc/shadow""" OR fp LIKE """/etc/sudoers*""" OR fp LIKE """*/.env""" OR fp LIKE """*/.env.*""" OR fp LIKE """*/.kube/config""" OR fp LIKE """*/.netrc""" OR fp LIKE """*/.docker/config.json""" OR fp LIKE """*id_rsa*""" OR fp LIKE """*id_ed25519*""" OR fp LIKE """*.pem""" OR fp LIKE """*.key""" OR fp LIKE """*.p12""" OR fp LIKE """*.pfx""" OR fp LIKE """*/.git-credentials""" OR fp LIKE """*/.config/gh/hosts.yml""" OR fp LIKE """*/.npmrc""" OR fp LIKE """*/.pypirc""" OR fp LIKE """*/login data""" OR fp LIKE """*/key4.db""" OR fp LIKE """*/.bash_history""" OR fp LIKE """*/.zsh_history""" OR fp LIKE """*/.claude/.credentials.json""" OR fp LIKE """*/.claude.json""") AND NOT (fp LIKE "*.example" OR fp LIKE "*.sample" OR fp LIKE "*.template")) | EVAL file_path = claude_code.tool_input.file_path | KEEP @timestamp, _id, _index, _version, user.name, host.name, claude_code.sessionId, claude_code.project_slug, claude_code.message.content.name, file_path
author: claude-code-elastic
